schema.note: Same schema as holes.json. Extra keys: hole.bonus, hole.felt[].color (felt tint), hole.tee.sign ([x, z] tee-sign spot), hole.decor_parts (visual-only primitives), placement (world origin/yaw).

physics.source: RobloxDevBot real game values (mirrored as constants in tools/sim.py)
physics.max_putt_note: V_MAX derived so a full putt rolls 60 studs (18 m) on flat felt = longest single-stroke run any hole needs (H6/H9 ace lines)

holes.name: The Goose
holes.landmark: A goose seen from above, on a cloud above the Grandmother Tree
holes.gimmick: Long S-curved neck: bank through two bends to the head; the cup is the goose's eye
holes.notes: Stage gg2 bonus hole, generated by games/vr-mini-golf/tools/gg2_goose.py. HoleNumber 10 is a label only (Bonus Hole 10): the hole is not part of the 9-hole round (Courses.holes skips Bonus holes).
